review.finding: _load_pin() still catches only (json.JSONDecodeError, KeyError), not (OSError, UnicodeError) -- the same class this round's fix closed in _resolve(). Pre-existing, adjacent, out of scope for this narrow fix.
review.suggestion: Widen _load_pin's except tuple in a future touch of this file.

review.finding: _check_pinned_worktree does raw string equality on a filesystem path with no normalization. No current call site can produce a spelling divergence (pin/ship/verify pass the identical --campaign-worktree), but this is forward-looking-only fragility.
review.suggestion: Normalize before comparing, or document byte-identical spelling as the intended contract.

review.finding: The ship-worktree-check test's loop_state row carries a redundant review_skipped key not read by resolve_unit_identity -- the pin() kwarg is what actually matters.
verify()'s docstring enumeration of raise cases is stale after adding the worktree cross-check.
review.suggestion: Add the new case to both the docstring and check_review_attribution.py's enumeration.

summary: PASS across three follow-up rounds remediating the external Tier-3 PR Review's findings on commit 9fabdb795: (1) _resolve() now wraps json.JSONDecodeError/OSError/UnicodeError/AttributeError/TypeError as ReviewAttributionError instead of letting them escape uncaught -- fixed across two rounds after a fresh reviewer caught the first attempt's tuple still missing UnicodeError; (2) verify()/ship() now cross-check the pin's recorded worktree against the unit's current loop_state.json resolution via a new _check_pinned_worktree(), closing a genuine gap the external reviewer found on its second BLOCK. All fixes independently confirmed red-before/green-after; all four remaining findings are low-severity and non-blocking, deferred to the next touch of this file per this campaign's established practice (round 13's own precedent). Two other external-reviewer findings (unvalidated shell interpolation of {branch}/{id}/{loop_id} in campaign-mode.md; the operator-trust-model D7 item) were rebutted in writing in the master ADR, not fixed -- accepted by the maintainer as the basis for a --admin merge override on the still-BLOCKing external check.
